fingerprint-hardware-concurrency.description: Allowed CPU core counts per persona platform; values are not the host core count.

window-size.description: WIDTH,HEIGHT window size passed to the kernel; window size only, never a screen resolution.

disable-spoofing.description: Spoof categories supported by this artifact for every persona platform; any other category must be rejected.

limitations: Windows desktop is a follow-up host; the manifest records the pinned artifact.
DoH and IPv6 controls are not implemented on this host yet (declared `unsupported`); proxied profiles must not launch on this platform until the controls exist.
Host-bound screen size, devicePixelRatio, color depth and font enumeration remain observable.
Headless pseudo_headful mode changes UA only; other Headless characteristics remain.
CreepJS may stall in some Windows environments (#108); probe timeouts must not be reported as spec failures.
Canvas sub-region readback can differ from full-surface readback (#98, #99); probe reports must attribute the gap to the kernel, not to the spec.
